metadata.description: AVH-specific fork of Mapleton Hill's pm-agent plugin, focused on Figma-driven Linear ticket creation.

plugins.name: pm-agent
plugins.description: AVH Contentful migration toolkit: a Linear issue agent focused on turning Figma designs into fully-specified tickets (a whole backlog, or the single ticket for one page, decomposed into sub issues when needed), plus drafting and triage skills, all held to a coding-agent readiness bar.
